object.name: WidgetQuery
object.description: This object represents an incoming query from a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
object.html_description: This object represents an incoming query from a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
object.rst_description: This object represents an incoming query from a widget in a message sent by the bot or via the bot. Use :class:`aiogram.methods.answer_widget_query.AnswerWidgetQuery` to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.

annotations.rst_description: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the widget was sent

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Chat with the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Identifier of the message containing the widget; omitted if the widget is in an inline message

annotations.description: For widgets in inline messages, type of the chat to which the message was sent. Can be either 'sender' for a private chat with the inline query sender, 'private', 'group', 'supergroup', or 'channel'.
annotations.html_description: Optional. For widgets in inline messages, type of the chat to which the message was sent. Can be either “sender” for a private chat with the inline query sender, “private”, “group”, “supergroup”, or “channel”.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. For widgets in inline messages, type of the chat to which the message was sent. Can be either 'sender' for a private chat with the inline query sender, 'private', 'group', 'supergroup', or 'channel'.
